1. Oben auf „Login-Seite öffnen“ klicken:
1. Click 'Open login page' above (a new browser tab opens).
2. In the new tab, press F12 and switch to the 'Network' tab.
3. Enable persistent logging:
   • Chrome / Edge / Brave: Check 'Preserve log'.
   • Firefox: Click gear ⚙️ ➔ check 'Persist Logs'.
1. E-Mail und Passwort deines Miele-App-:
1. Enter your Miele app account email and password and click 'Sign in'.
2. Note: After login, the page will hang on a spinning loading wheel (or show an error). This is completely normal and indicates success!
Schritt 3: Adresse kopieren & GroupKey e: Step 3: Copy redirect address & fetch GroupKey
1. Im Netzwerk-Tab (F12) ganz nach unten:
1. In the Network tab (F12), scroll to the very last (often red) request starting with 'redirect?redirect_uri=miele...' or 'miele://oauth2-code/...'.
2. Right-click that entry ➔ 'Copy URL' / 'Copy link address'.
3. Paste the URL into the field below and click 'Fetch GroupKey'.
Der Adapter ermittelt die lokalen Zugang: The adapter retrieves local credentials (GroupID/GroupKey) once by signing in with your Miele account. The Miele app continues to work as before. No credentials are transmitted to third parties.
Nach erfolgreicher Ermittlung stehen Gro: Once retrieved, GroupID and encrypted GroupKey appear on the 'Advanced' tab. Don't forget to save.
Wie viele der letzten Programme in cycle: How many recent cycles are kept in cyclesJson. Meant for quick display; long-term data comes from the history adapter.
Ältere Einträge fallen aus dem Ringpuffe: Older entries drop out of the ring buffer. 730 days is two years.
Zusätzlich in den History-Adapter schrei: Also write to the history adapter
Energie, Wasser und Dauer je Programm mi: Energy, water and duration per cycle, timestamped at the end of the cycle – so charts can cover any period.
Der Adapter schreibt jedes abgeschlossen: The adapter records every completed cycle: duration, program, energy and water. The appliances do not keep finished cycles themselves, so the history starts when you enable this – it cannot be filled retroactively. Recent cycles are available as JSON under <serial>.history.cyclesJson, the totals next to it.
